title: Spherical Law of Sines OQ-02: Squared Ratio Formalization

problemStatement.formal: For unit vectors A, B, C with nondegenerate projected sides, prove equality of the squared spherical law-of-sines ratios such as sin^2(arcLen(B,C))/sin^2(angle_A) = sin^2(arcLen(A,C))/sin^2(angle_B).
problemStatement.plain: Formalizes the spherical law of sines in squared form. The proof derives the shared ratio from triple products, perpendicular projections, and dihedral-angle sine identities.
whyMatters: The law of sines is one of the basic computational tools of spherical trigonometry.
The squared formulation avoids orientation and sign choices while preserving the theorem's algebraic content.
The entry gives exact theorem names for the projection and triple-product identities used in the proof.

proven: `sin_sq_arcLen` expresses squared sine of an arc length as a projected norm square.
`sin_sq_dihedralAngle` relates squared sine of the dihedral angle to the squared triple product.
`spherical_law_of_sines_sq` proves the two-ratio squared law of sines.
`spherical_law_of_sines_all_sq` proves equality of all three squared ratios.
`SphericalLawOfSines.lean` is recorded with 0 axioms and 0 sorries.
open: The unsquared signed ratio form, with orientation and positivity conditions made explicit, is not the theorem exported by this file.
knownResults.goal: Make the proved squared spherical law-of-sines formalization discoverable from the problem metadata.
